title: ناشئ — NASHE
description: Title slide — Connecting youth sports talent across the Arab world.

title: The Problem
description: Young athletes — boys and girls — go unseen across all sports in the Arab world.

title: The Solution
description: Mobile-first Arabic platform connecting youth coaches and clubs with emerging talent across all sports.

title: Key Features
description: Discovery Feed, Upload Clips, Athlete Profiles, All Sports, Arabic-First.

title: App Screens
description: Login, Discovery Feed, and Upload Clips — built with Expo React Native.

title: How It Works
description: Four-step flow: Log In → Film and Upload → Clip Goes Live → Connect.

title: Technology Stack
description: Expo/React Native, Node.js API, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, pnpm workspace.

title: Roadmap
description: Four phases: Phase 1 complete (all sports, boys and girls), Phases 2–4 planned.

title: Let's Build the Future of Arab Youth Sports
description: Closing slide — every young athlete, every sport, across the Arab world.
